label: Command palette query typed
verdict:
Not clean — a few real issues:

1. **Bottom-center slider looks broken (worst offender).** The "Sun" button sits on top of the time/terrain track, splitting it into mismatched dark/light fragments on both sides. It's unclear if it's one slider, two sliders, or a button overlapping a control. Worse, it's labeled "5 ft" while the status bar below says "Brush: 8 ft" — contradictory data, so a user can't tell what this control actually adjusts.
2. **"FPS: 1" in the status bar.** Either the app is genuinely rendering at 1 frame per second (severe performance problem) or the stat is mislabeled/broken. Either way it reads as something being wrong. It's also visually orphaned — far right of the other status items with a large empty gap.
3. **"Innovate" button** in the bottom tool row (Tape Measure / Terrain / Excavate / Analyze / **Innovate**) is semantically out of place — likely a typo for "Illuminate" — and doesn't read as an action.
4. **Redundant, competing surfaces.** Terrain/Analyze commands appear three times (open search results, floating Sculpt panel, bottom toolbar) with no visible indication of which is active. Confusing for a new user.
5. **The search overlay has no search affordance** — no icon, placeholder, or "Search tools" hint, and no visible close button. Typed text "terrain" makes it guessable, but a first-time user won't know what it is or how to dismiss it. It also sits only ~8px above the Sculpt panel, making them look attached.
6. **Minor:** the "Patio" row at the bottom of the left sidebar is clipped mid-row at the panel edge — fine if scrollable, but looks cut off.

**(2) 5-second comprehension:** Mostly yes — left "Add to your yard" palette, top toolbar, and 3D canvas clearly read as a yard designer. The overlapping control cluster at bottom-center is the main obstacle; a new user would stare at the Sun/5-ft slider trying to decode it.

Not CLEAN; one-line summary: solid editor layout, but the broken/contradictory bottom-center slider, "FPS: 1" reading, "Innovate" typo, and triple-duplicated terrain commands need fixing before this screen makes sense.
